description: Scrape Amazon creator storefronts (/shop/{handle}): profile and social links, Idea Lists and their products, shoppable photos and videos, curations, and trending picks across 23 Amazon marketplaces.

crawlIdeaLists.description: When true, opens each Idea List (up to `maxLists`) and extracts individual products (up to `maxItemsPerList`). When false, only the list summary cards (title, declared item count, image, hearts, pinned) are emitted.
crawlIdeaLists.title: Crawl Idea List items

handles.description: Amazon influencer handles, e.g. `gearvlogz` (from amazon.com/shop/gearvlogz). Combined with `marketplaceDomain` to build the shop URL. At least one handle or `shopUrls` entry is required.
handles.title: Creator handles

includeCurations.description: Emit the creator's curations (themed post collections shown on the profile page) when tabs=all or profile.
includeCurations.title: Include curations

includeTrendingPicks.description: Emit the creator's trending-picks product carousel when tabs=all or profile.
includeTrendingPicks.title: Include trending picks

marketplaceDomain.description: Amazon domain to use when building shop URLs from `handles`.
marketplaceDomain.title: Marketplace domain

maxItemsPerList.description: Maximum number of product items to extract per Idea List.
maxItemsPerList.title: Max items per Idea List

maxLists.description: Maximum number of Idea Lists to process per shop.
maxLists.title: Max Idea Lists per shop

maxPhotos.description: Maximum number of shoppable photo posts to extract per shop (tabs=all or photos).
maxPhotos.title: Max photos per shop

maxVideos.description: Maximum number of creator videos to extract per shop (tabs=all or videos).
maxVideos.title: Max videos per shop

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor chooses a working connection automatically (direct, then free AUTO, then residential only after repeated blocks). Change this only if you need a specific proxy setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchPosts.description: Optional keyword to filter the creator's posts (Idea Lists, photos, videos) before extraction. Leave empty to return the full feed.
searchPosts.title: Search posts

shopUrls.description: Full creator storefront URLs, e.g. `https://www.amazon.com/shop/gearvlogz`. Use this for non-default marketplaces or when you already have the exact URL. Provide at least one handle or shop URL.
shopUrls.title: Shop URLs

tabs.description: Which storefront content to extract. `all` includes profile, Idea Lists, photos, videos, curations, and trending picks.
enumTitles: All (profile + Idea Lists + photos + videos + curations + trending)
Profile only (includes curations and trending picks)
tabs.title: Content to scrape

title: Amazon Creator Shop Scraper Input
